chapter_title_en: The Birth of a New King
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 343: Xiao Chen Awakens as a Skeleton King in the Underworld
chapter_meta_description: After years as a skeleton in the death world, Xiao Chen kills the regional king, recovers his lost memories, and sets out to explore the demon well's terrible depths.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 343: The Skeleton King's Memory Returns
og_description: In a brutal turn of fate, Xiao Chen ascends to kingship among the undead and recalls his human identity, vowing to truly resurrect.
twitter_title: WoI Ch. 343: Xiao Chen's Underworld Ascension
twitter_description: Xiao Chen becomes a skeleton king, regains his memory, and begins his quest for true resurrection in the demon well world.
